title: Website development
meta_title: Website development in Vadodara | Artificia AI
meta_description: Fast websites your team can edit, with forms that send every enquiry to your CRM. We built orkaytiles.com. Start with a free 15-minute flow audit.

fields.subheading: We build fast websites your team can edit, with forms that send every enquiry straight to your CRM.

fields.heading: What you *get*
fields.body:
A website should bring in enquiries, not just look good. We build sites that load fast, are set up for search, and hand every lead to your sales team.

You also get an admin your team can edit without a developer.

items.title: Enquiries
items.before: The contact form emails one inbox, and leads get lost.
items.after: Every enquiry lands in your CRM with the page it came from.

items.title: Updates
items.before: Each small change waits for a developer.
items.after: Your team edits pages, products and posts in a simple admin.

items.title: Moving from an old site
items.before: Old pages vanish, and their Google traffic goes with them.
items.after: Old addresses redirect to the new pages, so links keep working.

steps.title: Plan the pages
steps.text: We agree the pages, what each one should rank for, and where enquiries go.

steps.title: Design and build
steps.text: Fast pages built for phones first, with your real products and photos.

steps.title: Connect the forms
steps.text: Forms send leads to GoHighLevel or your CRM, with the source attached.

steps.title: Launch and hand over
steps.text: Old URLs redirected, search set up, and your team shown the admin.

fields.heading: We built *orkaytiles.com*
fields.summary: A new website for a tile manufacturer in Morbi, with an admin Orkay's team edits and enquiry forms that send leads to GoHighLevel.

built.title: Collection pages
built.text: Each tile collection has its own page, with sizes, finishes and photos.

built.title: An editable admin
built.text: Orkay's team edits pages, products and SEO settings themselves.

built.title: Old links kept
built.text: Addresses from the old site redirect to the new pages.

built.title: Enquiries to the CRM
built.text: B2B enquiry forms send leads into GoHighLevel.

items.question: Can my team edit the site after launch?
items.answer: Yes. You get an admin where your team edits pages, images and SEO settings without a developer.

items.question: Will we lose our Google traffic?
items.answer: We map your old addresses to the new pages and redirect them, so existing links and search results keep working.

items.question: Can the site send leads to GoHighLevel?
items.answer: Yes. Forms can send each enquiry to GoHighLevel or another CRM, with the page and ad it came from.

items.question: Do you write the content too?
items.answer: We can. Our content team writes pages and posts, or we work from what you already have.

cards.title: GoHighLevel setup
cards.text: Somewhere for your website's leads to go next.

cards.title: Content and marketing
cards.text: Pages, posts and campaigns that bring visitors in.

cards.title: RAG and custom automation
cards.text: A site assistant that answers from your own documents.
